exceptions.rationale: This narrow pass-through chain does not authenticate or mutate state itself; it forwards the browser session and CSRF token to Identity, which validates both. The gateway's own authenticated BFF chain retains CSRF protection. Re-reviewed 2026-10-12: the source changes add same-origin Blaze/admin return paths; the local Identity pass-through chain and authenticated BFF CSRF enforcement are unchanged. Re-reviewed 2026-10-14 for DLV-810: Identity pass-through remains local-only and unchanged; BFF session CSRF remains enabled. Lower-cost DEV adds idle filtering and GET/HEAD-only safe static routes behind the separate fail-closed admission filter; authenticated API matchers still precede fallback. Exception remains limited to the existing local pass-through rule; no expiry extension. Fresh hosted CodeQL remains required. DLV-209 reviewed membership routes: public GET catalog only; purchases and staff writes retain bearer scopes and Gateway session CSRF. Role enforcement remains in the Domain service. Expiry unchanged. Re-reviewed 2026-10-21 following the expired-policy CI failure: exact source digest remains unchanged. Reviewed GatewayConfiguration, IdentityProxyController and GatewayController plus the cloud login/CSRF regression tests. Local Identity forwarding retains origin checks, bounded bodies and Identity-only cookies/CSRF headers; authenticated BFF CSRF remains enabled. Browser reauthentication only starts OAuth; reuse requires server authentication, stored client and Domain HTTP 200. Renewed for seven days through 2026-10-28; no rule, path or digest expansion. Fresh full hosted CodeQL and regression tests remain required; this renewal does not establish absence of findings. Re-reviewed 2026-10-27 for DLV-914: the only source change adds GET /actuator/info to the permitAll matchers of the authenticated BFF chain so the running Gateway reports build.version, releaseTag and sourceRevision; it is GET only, exposure stays health,info, and ActuatorInfoReleaseTest proves POST is rejected and nothing else is exposed. The Identity pass-through chain with the reviewed CSRF disable is unchanged; BFF session CSRF remains enabled. Digest re-bound to the new whole-source content; rule, path and expiry unchanged. Fresh hosted CodeQL remains required.

The browser reauthenticate=true parameter terminates session reuse by starting a fresh OAuth authorization flow; it never grants access or creates authentication. Reuse otherwise requires an OAuth2AuthenticationToken from the server security context, its stored authorized client, and Domain auth/me HTTP 200 using that client bearer and Gateway sign-in proof. Anonymous, missing-client and Domain-rejected sessions start OAuth. CloudGatewaySecurityIntegrationTest verifies these boundaries. Reviewed against the reported completed full scan; exact whole-source binding and expiry apply. Re-reviewed 2026-10-12: added review/staff proxy routes require server OAuth authentication and retain BFF CSRF, bounded bodies and fixed Domain upstream; the login reuse and forced-reauthentication logic is unchanged. Fresh hosted CodeQL analysis is still required. Re-reviewed 2026-10-14 for DLV-810: login/reuse/reauthenticate logic is unchanged. Logout now calls clearLearner, which invalidates the old session and clears SecurityContext, preserving only typed DEV admission state in a new session; admission is not learner authentication. Existing cloud login boundary and DEV logout tests remain required. No rule/path expansion or expiry extension; fresh hosted CodeQL remains required. DLV-930 review: exact POST-only invitation activation added to staff proxy allowlist, query strings rejected and session CSRF retained. Login reuse logic unchanged; expiry unchanged. DLV-209 reviewed membership routes: public GET catalog only; purchases and staff writes retain bearer scopes and Gateway session CSRF. Role enforcement remains in the Domain service. Expiry unchanged. DLV-961 review 2026-10-16: account directory GET, access-summary and test-account/reset routes require server OAuth authentication and server-owned bearer forwarding. BFF mutation CSRF remains enabled, query strings remain rejected for mutations, and login reuse/reauthentication logic is unchanged. Exact rule/file and expiry unchanged. DLV-962/963 conflict integration review 2026-10-16: retained exact account and test-account paths, including POST-only downgrade/delete and UUID matching. These routes remain behind the authenticated BFF security chain and session CSRF; the operator-only Identity route is never exposed through Gateway. Forced reauthentication logic is unchanged.
